record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:517 — updateAllCalendarEvents awaits a prisma.credential.findUnique inside the per-reference loop (N+1) instead of batch-fetching the missing credentials with a single findMany

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `updateAllCalendarEvents` was changed to handle an array of calendar references (`calendarReference = ...filter(...)`), and then iterates `for (const reference of calendarReference)`. Inside that per-reference loop, when `reference.credentialId` is set but not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` to fetch the credential. With multiple references this can trigger one DB query per missing credential (N+1 pattern). This is a performance/scale concern introduced by the new multi-reference behavior, not an immediate functional defect.
